text: 临床场景：同一批疑似感染患者同时接受新冠快速抗原检测（阳性率 80%）与 RT-PCR 核酸检测（阳性率 60%），预期不一致对占总对数的比例 \(\psi = 0.25\)。 数学公式与出处： \[n_{\text{pairs}} = \frac{\left[ Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{\psi} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{\psi - \delta^2} \right]^2}{\delta^2}, \quad \delta = |p_1 - p_2|\] 出处：Connor, R. J. (1987). Sample size for testing differences in proportions for the paired-sample design. Biometrics, 43(1), 207-211. #>  #>  Also: Akoglu, H. (2022). title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：复发/难治性淋巴瘤的历史最佳缓解率仅 70%（\(p_0 = 0.70\)），新的 CAR-T 细胞治疗方案预期提高至 80%（\(p_1 = 0.80\)）。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \frac{\left[ Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{p_0(1-p_0)} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p_1(1-p_1)} \right]^2}{(p_1 - p_0)^2}\] 出处：Hajian-Tilaki, K. (2014). J Biomed Inform, 48, 193-204 (Eq 6.8). 输出解读：需招募 153 名患者。

(2014). Sample size estimation in diagnostic test studies of biomedical informatics. Journal of Biomedical Informatics, 48, 193-204 (Eq 6.8; worked example 0.70 vs 0.80 -> n=153). #>  #>  Also: Akoglu, H. (2022). Table 2, Equation 2; Machin et al. id: 单臂肿瘤-ii-期simon-两阶段最优设计optimal
previous_headings: 第二章：配对、单臂与交叉临床试验
what: 2.5 单臂肿瘤 II 期：Simon 两阶段最优设计（Optimal）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：肉瘤新方案单臂 II 期试验：不可接受的历史响应率 \(p_0 = 0.10\)，期望目标响应率 \(p_1 = 0.30\)。采用 Simon Optimal 设计，使药物无效时的期望样本量最小。 数学公式与出处：完全精确二项网格穷举搜索，Simon, R. (1989). Controlled Clin Trials, 10(1), 1-10。设计 \((r_1/n_1, r/n)\) 需同时满足 \(P(\text{有效}\mid p_0) \le \alpha\) 与 \(P(\text{有效}\mid p_1) \ge 1-\beta\)。 输出解读：第 1 阶段招 10 人，缓解 \(\le 1\) 人则因无效停牌；若缓解 \(>1\) 人，继续招 19 人至 29 人。两阶段总缓解人数 \(>5\)（即 \(\ge 6\) 人）宣布有效。期望样本量仅 15.0 人。
code: res_2_5 <- calculate("singleArmPhaseII", "test", "proportion", p0 = 0.10, p1 = 0.30, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8, optimizer = "optimal") print(res_2_5) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Single-arm phase II (Simon two-stage, optimal)" #> • Stage 1 sample size: 10 #> • Stage 1 futility boundary (stop if responses <= r1): 1 #> • Total sample size (both stages): 29 #> • Overall boundary (declare effective if responses > r): 5 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • p0 = unacceptable response rate (null) #> • p1 = desirable response rate (alternative) #> • stage 1: stop for futility if responses <= r_stage_1 of n_stage_1 #> • overall: declare effective if responses > r_total of n_total #> Formula (plain text): #> `exact binomial: P(effective|p0) <= alpha and P(effective|p1) >= power` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$P(\text{reject } H_0 \mid p_0) \le \alpha \quad \text{and} \quad P(\text{reject } H_0 \mid p_1) \ge 1-\beta$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State phase II hypotheses: H0: p <= 0.10 (unacceptable) vs H1: p >= #> 0.30 (promising) (alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Exhaustive exact binomial search under 'optimal' criterion. #> • Step 3: Stage 1: Accrue n1 = 10 patients; stop early for futility if #> responses <= r1 = 1. #> • Step 4: Stage 2: If > 1 responses observed, accrue additional 19 patients up #> to total n = 29. #> • Step 5: Final decision: Declare effective if total responses > r = 5 #> (Expected sample size under H0 = 15). #> Reference: #> Primary: Simon, R. (1989). Optimal two-stage designs for phase II clinical trials. Controlled Clinical Trials, 10(1), 1-10. #>  #>  Also: Machin et al. (2018) Chapter 17 (Therapeutic Exploratory Trials). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 前瞻性队列研究累积发病率与-rr含脱落率
previous_headings: 第三章：观察性与流行病学研究实战
what: 3.1 前瞻性队列研究（累积发病率与 RR，含脱落率）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：吸烟与冠心病发病的弗莱明翰式队列：非吸烟组 5 年发病率 20%（\(p_0 = 0.20\)），吸烟组 30%（\(p_1 = 0.30\)），1:1 分组，预计 10% 失访（dropout = 0.10）。 数学公式与出处： \[n_{1} = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{(1+\frac{1}{m})\bar{p}(1-\bar{p})} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p_1(1-p_1)+\frac{p_0(1-p_0)}{m}}\right]^2}{(p_1-p_0)^2}, \quad n = \frac{n_1}{1-d}\] 出处：Bhardwaj et al. (2024). J Family Med Prim Care, 13(7), 2559. 输出解读：每组需 327 人，全队列共需 654 人。
code: res_3_1 <- calculate("cohort", "test", "proportion", p0 = 0.20, p1 = 0.30, ratio = 1, dropout = 0.10, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_3_1) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Cohort study (cumulative incidence, RR)" #> • Sample size per group: 327 #> • Exposed group: 327 #> • Unexposed group: 327 #> • Total sample size: 654 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • p0 = unexposed-group cumulative incidence #> • p1 = exposed-group cumulative incidence #> • ratio = unexposed:exposed allocation (m) #> • effect measure: risk ratio RR (estimable in cohort designs) #> Formula (plain text): #> `n1 = [Za*sqrt((1+1/m)*pbar*(1-pbar)) + Zb*sqrt(p1q1+p0q0/m)]^2/(p1-p0)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n_{1} = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{(1+\frac{1}{m})\bar{p}(1-\bar{p})} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p_1(1-p_1)+\frac{p_0(1-p_0)}{m}}\right]^2}{(p_1-p_0)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Specify proportions: unexposed p0 = 0.20, exposed p1 = 0.30, #> allocation ratio m = 1 (alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Weighted average proportion: p_bar = (p1 + m*p0) / (1 + m) = 0.25. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Calculate exposed sample size: n_exposed = #> [Z_(alpha/2)*sqrt((1+1/m)*p_bar*(1-p_bar)) + Z_beta*sqrt(p1*q1 + p0*q0/m)]^2 / #> (p1 - p0)^2 = 293.15. #> • Step 5: Calculate unexposed sample size: n_unexposed = m * n_exposed = 1 * #> 293.15 = 293.15. #> • Step 6: Round up before dropout inflation: ceiling(n_exposed) = 294, #> ceiling(m*n_exposed) = 294; apply dropout d = 0.10 using ceiling(n/(1-d)). #> Exposed = 327, Unexposed = 327, Total sample size N = 654. #> Reference: #> Primary: Bhardwaj et al. (2024). Journal of Family Medicine and Primary Care, 13(7), 2559 (worked example: p0=0.20, p1=0.30, m=1 -> 293/group). #>  #>  Also: Schlesselman, J. J. (1982). Case-Control Studies. Oxford University Press (cohort/case-control shared formula, roles swapped); Machin et al. (2018) Ch.3. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 队列研究人时发病率比irr比较
previous_headings: 第三章：观察性与流行病学研究实战
what: 3.2 队列研究人时发病率比（IRR）比较
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：职业流行病学：接触有机溶剂的工人发病率为 0.20 例/人年（\(\lambda_1\)），非接触工人为 0.10 例/人年（\(\lambda_0\)），1:1 人时分配。 数学公式与出处： \[T_0 = \frac{(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta})^2 (\lambda_1/r + \lambda_0)}{(\lambda_1 - \lambda_0)^2}, \quad T_1 = r \cdot T_0\] 出处：Machin et al. (2018) Chapter 6. 输出解读：两组各需随访 236 人年，预期观察到 71 例事件。
code: res_3_2 <- calculate("cohort", "test", "rate", rate0 = 0.10, rate1 = 0.20, ratio = 1, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_3_2) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Cohort study (incidence rate ratio, person-time)" #> • Person-time, exposed group: 236 #> • Person-time, unexposed group: 236 #> • Expected events: 71 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • rate0 = unexposed-group incidence rate (events per person-time) #> • rate1 = exposed-group incidence rate #> • ratio = unexposed:exposed person-time ratio #> • effect measure: incidence rate ratio IRR #> • person-time = total follow-up time; for fixed duration FT, subjects needed = #> person-time / FT #> Formula (plain text): #> `T0 = (Za/2+Zb)^2 * (l1/r + l0) / (l1-l0)^2 ; T1 = r*T0` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$T_{0} = \frac{(Z_{\alpha/2}+Z_{\beta})^2(\lambda_1/r+\lambda_0)}{(\lambda_1-\lambda_0)^2}, \quad T_1 = r \cdot T_0$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Specify incidence rates: unexposed lambda0 = 0.10, exposed lambda1 = #> 0.20, person-time ratio r = 1. #> • Step 2: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 3: Calculate required person-time for unexposed group: T0 = (Z_(alpha/2) #> + Z_beta)^2 * (lambda1/r + lambda0) / (lambda1 - lambda0)^2 = 235.47. #> • Step 4: Calculate required person-time for exposed group: T1 = r * T0 = 1 * #> 235.47 = 235.47. #> • Step 5: Expected events: E = lambda0 * T0 + lambda1 * T1 = 71. #> • Step 6: Round up to integer: Person-time unexposed = 236, Person-time exposed #> = 236. #> Reference: #> Primary: Machin, D., Campbell, M. J., Tan, S. B., & Tan, S. H. (2018). Sample Sizes for Clinical, Laboratory and Epidemiology Studies (4th ed.). Wiley. Chapter 6 (Rate Outcomes). #>  #>  Also: Breslow, N. E., & Day, N. E. (1987). Statistical Methods in Cancer Research Vol. II. IARC (person-time rate comparison). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：熬夜与心肌梗死的医院基病例对照研究：对照组 30% 有长期熬夜暴露（\(p_0\)），预期优势比 \(\text{} = 2.0\)，1 名对照匹配 1 名病例。 数学公式与出处： \[n_{cases} = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{(1+1/m)\bar{p}(1-\bar{p})} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p_1(1-p_1) + p_0(1-p_0)/m}\right]^2}{(p_1-p_0)^2}\] 出处：Schlesselman, J. J. (1982). Case-Control Studies. Oxford University Press. 输出解读：需纳入 141 例病例与 141 例对照（总计 282 人）。
code: res_3_3 <- calculate("caseControl", p0 = 0.30, OR = 2.0, m = 1, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_3_3) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Case-control" #> • Cases needed: 141 #> • Controls needed: 141 #> • Total subjects: 282 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n_cases = [Z_alpha/2 * sqrt((1+1/m)*p_bar*(1-p_bar)) + Z_beta * sqrt(p1*(1-p1) #> + p0*(1-p0)/m)]^2 / (p1 - p0)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n_{cases} = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{(1+1/m)\bar{p}(1-\bar{p})} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p_1(1-p_1) + p_0(1-p_0)/m}\right]^2}{(p_1-p_0)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Compute case exposure rate from Odds Ratio: p1 = (OR * p0) / (1 - p0 #> + OR * p0) = (2 * 0.30) / (1 - 0.30 + 2 * 0.30) = 0.4615. #> • Step 2: Weighted average exposure (matching ratio m = 1): p_bar = (p1 + m*p0) #> / (1 + m) = 0.3808. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Schlesselman formula for cases: n_cases = #> [Z_(alpha/2)*sqrt((1+1/m)*p_bar*(1-p_bar)) + Z_beta*sqrt(p1*(1-p1) + #> p0*(1-p0)/m)]^2 / (p1 - p0)^2 = 140.66. #> • Step 5: Calculate controls needed: n_controls = m * n_cases = 1 * 140.66 = #> 140.66. #> • Step 6: Round up to integer: Cases needed = 141, Controls needed = 141, Total #> subjects = 282. #> Reference: #> Primary: Schlesselman, J. J. (1982). Case-control studies: Design, conduct, analysis. Oxford University Press. #>  #> IARC classic: Breslow, N. E., & Day, N. E. (1980). Statistical methods in cancer research: Volume I - The analysis of case-control studies. IARC Scientific Publications No. 32. #>  #> For individually matched designs (not the formula implemented here): Dupont, W. D. (1988). Power calculations for matched case-control studies. Biometrics, 44(4), 1157-1168; see the caseControlMatched design. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 个体配对病例对照研究
previous_headings: 第三章：观察性与流行病学研究实战
what: 3.4 1:1 个体配对病例对照研究
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：年轻女性口服避孕药与缺血性卒中的按年龄 1:1 严格配对病例对照研究：对照暴露率 30%，\(\text{} = 2.0\)。 数学公式与出处： \[n_{pairs} = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{\psi} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{\psi-\delta^2}\right]^2}{\delta^2}, \quad \psi = p_1(1-p_0)+p_0(1-p_1)\] 出处：Dupont, W. D. (1988). Biometrics, 44(4), 1157-1168. 输出解读：需纳入 144 对（288 人）。
code: res_3_4 <- calculate("caseControlMatched", p0 = 0.30, OR = 2.0, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_3_4) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Individually matched case-control (1:1)" #> • Total sample size: 288 #> • Cases needed: 144 #> • Controls needed: 144 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • p0 = control-group exposure rate #> • OR = odds ratio to detect (p1 derived from p0 and OR) #> • psi = expected discordant-pair proportion (pi10 + pi01 = p1*(1-p0) + #> p0*(1-p1)) #> • note = individually matched designs require discordant-pair proportions #> (psi), NOT the discordant odds ratio #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = [Za*sqrt(psi) + Zb*sqrt(psi-delta^2)]^2/delta^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n_{pairs} = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{\psi} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{\psi-\delta^2}\right]^2}{\delta^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Matched case-control parameters: control exposure p0 = 0.30, Odds #> Ratio OR = 2 (alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Case exposure rate: p1 = (OR * p0) / (1 - p0 + OR * p0) = 0.4615. #> • Step 3: Discordant pair probability: psi = pi10 + pi01 = 0.4846; difference #> delta = |pi10 - pi01| = 0.1615. #> • Step 4: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 5: Apply Dupont/Connor formula: n_pairs = [Z_(alpha/2)*sqrt(psi) + #> Z_beta*sqrt(psi - delta^2)]^2 / delta^2 = 143.38. #> • Step 6: Round up to integer: Pairs needed = 144 (Cases = 144, Controls = #> 144). #> Reference: #> Primary: Dupont, W. D. (1988). Power calculations for matched case-control studies. Biometrics, 44(4), 1157-1168. #>  #>  Also: Schlesselman, J. J. (1982). Case-Control Studies, Oxford University Press (matched-pair approximation, p.174); Connor, R. J. (1987). Biometrics, 43(1), 207-211. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 现况研究-横断面调查关联分析
previous_headings: 第三章：观察性与流行病学研究实战
what: 3.5 现况研究 / 横断面调查关联分析
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：某社区横断面调查高血压与肥胖的关联：非肥胖人群高血压患病率 20%，肥胖人群 30%。 数学公式与出处：与 3.1 同核（\(m = 1\)）；Machin et al. (2018) Chapter 3. 输出解读：两组各需调查 294 人，总计 588 人。
code: res_3_5 <- calculate("crosstab", p0 = 0.20, p1 = 0.30, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_3_5) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Cross-sectional study (prevalence comparison, PR/OR)" #> • Sample size per group: 294 #> • Exposed group: 294 #> • Unexposed group: 294 #> • Total sample size: 588 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • p0 = prevalence in unexposed group #> • p1 = prevalence in exposed group #> • effect measure: prevalence ratio PR (or OR) #> • sampling: exposure and outcome observed at the same time point #> Formula (plain text): #> `n1 = [Za*sqrt((1+1/m)*pbar*(1-pbar)) + Zb*sqrt(p1q1+p0q0/m)]^2/(p1-p0)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n_{1} = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{(1+\frac{1}{m})\bar{p}(1-\bar{p})} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p_1(1-p_1)+\frac{p_0(1-p_0)}{m}}\right]^2}{(p_1-p_0)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Specify proportions: unexposed p0 = 0.20, exposed p1 = 0.30, #> allocation ratio m = 1 (alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Weighted average proportion: p_bar = (p1 + m*p0) / (1 + m) = 0.25. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Calculate exposed sample size: n_exposed = #> [Z_(alpha/2)*sqrt((1+1/m)*p_bar*(1-p_bar)) + Z_beta*sqrt(p1*q1 + p0*q0/m)]^2 / #> (p1 - p0)^2 = 293.15. #> • Step 5: Calculate unexposed sample size: n_unexposed = m * n_exposed = 1 * #> 293.15 = 293.15. #> • Step 6: Round up to integer: Exposed = 294, Unexposed = 294, Total sample #> size N = 588. #> Reference: #> Primary: Machin, D., Campbell, M. J., Tan, S. B., & Tan, S. H. (2018). Sample Sizes for Clinical, Laboratory and Epidemiology Studies (4th ed.). Wiley. Chapter 3 (Binary Outcomes). #>  #>  Also: Bhardwaj et al. (2024), p. 2558-2559. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 总体比例估计患病率抽样调查
previous_headings: 第四章：单组参数置信区间估计（调查与常模）
what: 4.1 总体比例估计（患病率抽样调查）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：某县成人糖尿病患病率抽样调查：预期患病率 10%，要求估计值与真值的误差不超过 ±2 个百分点（\(d = 0.02\)），95% 置信水平。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \frac{Z_{1-\alpha/2}^2 p(1-p)}{d^2}\] 出处：Lwanga & Lemeshow (1991) ；Bhardwaj et al. (2024), p. 2558. 输出解读：需调查 865 名居民。
code: res_4_1 <- calculate("singleProportion", p = 0.10, precision = 0.02, alpha = 0.05) print(res_4_1) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Single proportion estimation (precision)" #> • Required sample size: 865 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • p = expected proportion (e.g. prevalence) #> • precision = margin of error d (half-width of the CI) #> • confidence level = 95% #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = Z^2 * p(1-p) / d^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \frac{Z_{1-\alpha/2}^2 \cdot p(1-p)}{d^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Specify anticipated proportion p = 0.10, margin of error d = 0.02 #> (absolute precision), alpha = 0.05. #> • Step 2: Determine critical value: Z_(1-alpha/2) = 1.96 (confidence level = #> 95%). #> • Step 3: Compute variance component: p * (1 - p) = 0.10 * 0.90 = 0.09. #> • Step 4: Calculate unrounded sample size: n = Z_(1-alpha/2)^2 * p * (1 - p) / #> d^2 = (1.96)^2 * 0.09 / (0.02)^2 = 864.33. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: Required sample size n = 865. #> Reference: #> Bhardwaj et al. (2024). Determination of sample size for various study designs in medical research: A practical primer. Journal of Family Medicine and Primary Care, 13(7), 2555-2561 (p. 2558). #>  #> Also: Lwanga, S. K., & Lemeshow, S. (1991). Sample size determination in health studies: A practical manual. World Health Organization. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 总体均数估计常模抽样
previous_headings: 第四章：单组参数置信区间估计（调查与常模）
what: 4.2 总体均数估计（常模抽样）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：建立某地健康儿童血清铁蛋白参考值：已知人群标准差 \(\text{SD} = 10\) μg/L，均数估计误差需控制在 \(\pm 2\) μg/L 内。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \left(\frac{Z_{1-\alpha/2}\sigma}{d}\right)^2\] 出处：Machin et al. (2018) Ch.9. 输出解读：需调查 97 名儿童。
code: res_4_2 <- calculate("singleMean", sigma = 10, precision = 2, alpha = 0.05) print(res_4_2) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Single mean estimation (precision)" #> • Required sample size: 97 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • sigma = population standard deviation (from pilot/literature) #> • precision = margin of error d #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = (Z * sigma / d)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \left(\frac{Z_{1-\alpha/2} \cdot \sigma}{d}\right)^2$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Specify population SD sigma = 10, margin of error d = 2, alpha = #> 0.05. #> • Step 2: Determine critical value: Z_(1-alpha/2) = 1.96 (confidence level = #> 95%). #> • Step 3: Compute unrounded sample size: n = (Z_(1-alpha/2) * sigma / d)^2 = #> (1.96 * 10 / 2)^2 = 96.04. #> • Step 4: Round up to integer: Required sample size n = 97. #> Reference: #> Machin, D., Campbell, M. J., Tan, S. B., & Tan, S. H. (2018). Sample Sizes for Clinical, Laboratory and Epidemiology Studies (4th ed.). Wiley. Chapter 9. #>  #> Also: Bhardwaj et al. (2024), p. 2558 (continuous outcome precision). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

previous_headings: 第四章：单组参数置信区间估计（调查与常模）
what: 4.3 Pearson 相关系数估计（Fisher-z 精确法）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：验证腰围替代体脂率的可靠性：预期 Pearson 相关系数 \(r = 0.50\)，要求 95% 置信区间半宽不超过 \(\pm 0.10\)。 数学公式与出处： \[N_{P0} = \frac{4 z_{1-\alpha/2}^2 (1-r^2)^2}{w^2} + 3, \quad N_{Final} = (N_{P0}-3)\left(\frac{w_0}{w}\right)^2 + 3\] 出处：Machin et al. (2018) Ch.19 Eqs 19.5-19.8 精修公式，与 presize::prec_cor 严格一致。 输出解读：需纳入 219 名受试者。
code: res_4_3 <- calculate("singleCorrelation", r = 0.50, precision = 0.10, alpha = 0.05) print(res_4_3) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Single correlation estimation (Fisher z precision)" #> • Required sample size: 219 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • r = anticipated correlation coefficient #> • precision = margin of error d (CI half-width, w = 2*d) #> • confidence level = 95% #> Formula (plain text): #> `Machin 19.5-19.8: N_P0 = 4*z^2*(1-r^2)^2/w^2 + 3, refined via Fisher z bounds` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$N_{P0} = \frac{4 z_{1-\alpha/2}^2 (1-r^2)^2}{w^2} + 3, \quad N_{Final} = (N_{P0}-3)\left(\frac{w_0}{w}\right)^2 + 3$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Specify anticipated correlation r = 0.50, CI half-width d = 0.10 #> (width w = 2d = 0.20), alpha = 0.05. #> • Step 2: Determine critical value: Z_(1-alpha/2) = 1.96. #> • Step 3: Machin initial estimate: N_P0 = 4 * Z^2 * (1 - r^2)^2 / w^2 + 3 = #> 219.08. #> • Step 4: Refine via Fisher z transformation limits to adjust for confidence #> interval skewness. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: Required sample size n = 219. #> Reference: #> Primary: Machin, D., Campbell, M. J., Tan, S. B., & Tan, S. H. (2018). Sample Sizes for Clinical, Laboratory and Epidemiology Studies (4th ed.). Wiley. Chapter 19 (The Correlation Coefficient), Equations 19.5-19.8, pp. 307-308. #>  #>  Also: Fisher, R. A. (1921). On the 'probable error' of a coefficient of correlation deduced from a small sample. Metron, 1, 3-32. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 敏感度特异度估计与全人群筛查规模转化
previous_headings: 第五章：诊断试验准确性研究全家族
what: 5.1 敏感度/特异度估计与全人群筛查规模转化
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：验证结直肠癌早筛试剂盒的敏感度：预期 85%，95% 置信区间半宽需控制在 \(\pm 5\%\)，门诊目标人群患病率 20%。需多少确诊真病例？全人群需筛查多少人？ 数学公式与出处： \[n_{cases} = \frac{Z_{1-\alpha/2}^2 \cdot p(1-p)}{d^2}, \quad N_{screen} = \frac{n_{cases}}{\text{prevalence}}\] 出处：Zhou, Obuchowski, & McClish (2011) §6.1.1, pp. 194-196. 输出解读：敏感度需 196 例确诊真病例；门诊全人群筛查需 980 人。
code: res_5_1 <- calculate("diagAccuracy", "estimate", "proportion", prob = 0.85, d = 0.05, prevalence = 0.20, alpha = 0.05) print(res_5_1) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Diagnostic accuracy (single)" #> • Cases needed: 196 #> • Total subjects to screen: 980 #> • Total subjects: 980 #> Formula (plain text): #> `N_cases = (Z_1-a/2)^2 * P*(1-P)/d^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n_{{{cases}}} = \frac{Z_{1-\alpha/2}^2 \cdot p(1-p)}{d^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Specify diagnostic accuracy prob (Se or Sp) = 0.85, margin of error d #> = 0.05, prevalence = 0.20 (alpha = 0.05). #> • Step 2: Determine critical value: Z_(1-alpha/2) = 1.96 (confidence level = #> 95%). #> • Step 3: Calculate target cases required: n_cases = Z_sum^2 * prob * (1 - #> prob) / d^2 = (1.96)^2 * 0.85 * 0.15 / (0.05)^2 = 195.91. #> • Step 4: Adjust for disease prevalence: total subjects to screen = n_cases / #> prevalence = 195.91 / 0.20 = 979.57. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: Target cases needed = 196, Total subjects to #> screen = 980. #> Reference: #> Primary: Hanley, J. A., & McNeil, B. J. (1982). The meaning and use of the area under a receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve. Radiology, 143(1), 29-36. #>  #> Review: Hajian-Tilaki, K. (2014). Sample size estimation in diagnostic test studies of biomedical informatics. Journal of Biomedical Informatics, 48, 193-204. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

what: 5.2 诊断单端点优效性检验（渐近正态法）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：验证 AI 肺结节诊断系统的敏感度是否显著优于行业及格线 70%（\(p_0 = 0.70\)），预期敏感度 85%，患病率 20%。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha}\sqrt{p_0(1-p_0)} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p(1-p)}\right]^2}{(p - p_0)^2}\] 出处：Hajian-Tilaki (2014) Eq 6.8. 输出解读：需 50 例病例，筛查 250 人。

(2014). Sample size estimation in diagnostic test studies of biomedical informatics. Journal of Biomedical Informatics, 48, 193-204. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbi.2014.02.013 #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

what: 5.3 诊断单端点优效性检验（A’Hern 精确二项法）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：同上 AI 肺结节验证，但样本来源有限，采用精确二项法消除正态近似误差。 数学公式与出处：\(P(X \ge r \mid p_0) \le \alpha\) 且 \(P(X \ge r \mid p) \ge 1-\beta\)；’Hern (2001). 输出解读：精确法需 49 例确诊病例，临界正确数 \(r = 40\) 例（正确判断 \(\ge 40\) 例宣布优效）。
code: res_5_3 <- calculate("diagAccuracy", "test", "proportion", prob = 0.85, p0 = 0.70, prevalence = 0.20, method = "exact", alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_5_3) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Diagnostic superiority (single test, exact binomial)" #> • Cases needed: 49 #> • Total subjects to screen: 245 #> • Total subjects: 245 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • prob = expected diagnostic sensitivity/specificity #> • p0 = unacceptable/null sensitivity or specificity threshold #> • critical_successes = declare superior if correct cases >= 40 of 49 #> Formula (plain text): #> `exact binomial: P(X >= r | p0) <= alpha and P(X >= r | prob) >= power` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$P(X \ge r \mid p_0) \le \alpha \quad \text{and} \quad P(X \ge r \mid p) \ge 1-\beta$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Identify study design: Diagnostic superiority (single test, exact #> binomial). #> • Step 2: Input parameters: prob = 0.85, p0 = 0.70, prevalence = 0.20, alpha = #> 0.05, power = 0.80, method = exact. #> • Step 3: Apply design formula: exact binomial: P(X >= r | p0) <= alpha and P(X #> >= r | prob) >= power. #> • Step 4: Calculated sample size metrics: Cases needed: 49; Total subjects to #> screen: 245. #> Reference: #> Primary (exact binomial): A'Hern, R. P. (2001). Single stage and double sampling phase II trials. British Journal of Cancer, 85(2), 223-226. #>  #>  Also: Hajian-Tilaki, K. (2014). Sample size estimation in diagnostic test studies of biomedical informatics. Journal of Biomedical Informatics, 48, 193-204. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 双端点诊断试验设计敏感度特异度协同达标
previous_headings: 第五章：诊断试验准确性研究全家族
what: 5.4 双端点诊断试验设计（敏感度+特异度协同达标）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：新的乳腺病灶 AI 需要敏感度（80%升至90%）与特异度（75%升至85%）同时较活检金标准显著提升，患病率 40%。各端点置于 90% 效能，联合效能约 80%。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \max\left(n_{Se},\, n_{Sp}\right), \quad n = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha}\sqrt{p_0(1-p_0)} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p(1-p)}\right]^2}{(p-p_0)^2}\] 出处：Akoglu, H. (2022). Turk J Emerg Med, 22(4), 177-185 (p. 184)。 输出解读：需 123 例病例，全人群需筛查 308 人。
code: res_5_4 <- calculate("diagAccuracy", "test", "proportion", prob = 0.90, p0 = 0.80, prob_spec = 0.85, p0_spec = 0.75, prevalence = 0.40, dual = TRUE) print(res_5_4) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Diagnostic accuracy (dual endpoint: Se + Sp)" #> • Cases needed: 137 #> • N for sensitivity: 109 #> • N for specificity: 137 #> • Total subjects to screen: 343 #> • Total subjects: 343 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • prob/p0 = expected and null sensitivity #> • prob_spec/p0_spec = expected and null specificity #> • dual_power = per-endpoint power (default 0.90 -> ~80% joint) #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = [Za*sqrt(p0q0) + Zb*sqrt(pq)]^2/(p-p0)^2, each at dual_power; take max` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \max\left(n_{Se},\, n_{Sp}\right), \quad n = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha}\sqrt{p_0(1-p_0)} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p(1-p)}\right]^2}{(p-p_0)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Dual-endpoint setup: Se (null = 0.80, exp = 0.90), Sp (null = 0.75, #> exp = 0.85), dual_power = 0.90 (joint power ~80%). #> • Step 2: Calculate cases for sensitivity: n_Se = [Z_alpha*sqrt(p0*q0) + #> Z_beta*sqrt(p*q)]^2 / (p - p0)^2 = 109. #> • Step 3: Calculate controls for specificity: n_Sp = [Z_alpha*sqrt(p0*q0) + #> Z_beta*sqrt(p*q)]^2 / (p - p0)^2 = 137. #> • Step 4: Select dominant endpoint requirement: n_final = max(n_Se, n_Sp) = #> 137. #> • Step 5: Convert to screening population: Total subjects to screen = 137 / #> 0.40 = 343. #> Reference: #> Strategy: Akoglu, H. (2022). User's guide to sample size estimation in diagnostic accuracy studies. Turkish Journal of Emergency Medicine, 22(4), 177-185 (p. 184: each endpoint at 90% power -> ~80% overall). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

what: 5.5 非配对两诊断方法敏感度比较
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：两套竞争性肺炎 CT-AI 系统在两组独立患者中验证：敏感度分别为 85% 与 75%，患病率 20%。 数学公式与出处：与 1.2 同核（Fleiss 1980 渐近方差公式）。 输出解读：每组需 250 例病例，两组筛查需 2500 人。
code: res_5_5 <- calculate("diagAccuracyCompare", "test", "proportion", p1 = 0.85, p2 = 0.75, prevalence = 0.20, paired = FALSE, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_5_5) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Two diagnostic measures" #> • Cases needed: 250 #> • Total subjects to screen: 2500 #> • Total subjects: 2500 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = [Za/2 * sqrt(2*p_bar*(1-p_bar)) + Zb * sqrt(p1*(1-p1)+p2*(1-p2))]^2 / #> (p1-p2)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{2\bar{p}(1-\bar{p})} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p_1(1-p_1)+p_2(1-p_2)}\right]^2}{(p_1-p_2)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Identify study design: Two diagnostic measures. #> • Step 2: Input parameters: p1 = 0.85, p2 = 0.75, prevalence = 0.20, paired = #> FALSE, psi = , alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80. #> • Step 3: Apply design formula: n = [Za/2 * sqrt(2*p_bar*(1-p_bar)) + Zb * #> sqrt(p1*(1-p1)+p2*(1-p2))]^2 / (p1-p2)^2. #> • Step 4: Calculated sample size metrics: Cases needed: 250; Total subjects to #> screen: 2500. #> Reference: #> Primary: Hanley, J. A., & McNeil, B. J. (1982). The meaning and use of the area under a receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve. Radiology, 143(1), 29-36. #>  #> Review: Hajian-Tilaki, K. (2014). Sample size estimation in diagnostic test studies of biomedical informatics. Journal of Biomedical Informatics, 48, 193-204. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 配对两诊断方法敏感度比较connor-核
previous_headings: 第五章：诊断试验准确性研究全家族
what: 5.6 配对两诊断方法敏感度比较（Connor 核）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：同一批疑似肺炎患者同时接受两套 AI 系统判读（配对设计）：敏感度 85% vs 75%，预期不一致对比例 \(\psi = 0.10\)——配对设计大幅节省病例数。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{\psi} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{\psi-\delta^2}\right]^2}{\delta^2}\] 出处：Connor (1987)；Akoglu (2022) Tables 6A/6B。 输出解读：仅需 77 对病例，筛查 385 人。
code: res_5_6 <- calculate("diagAccuracyCompare", "test", "proportion", p1 = 0.85, p2 = 0.75, prevalence = 0.20, paired = TRUE, psi = 0.10, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_5_6) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Two diagnostic measures (paired, Connor)" #> • Pairs needed: 77 #> • Total subjects to screen: 381 #> • Cases needed: 77 #> • Total subjects: 381 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • p1/p2 = expected sensitivities of the two tests #> • psi = expected discordant-pair proportion (pi10 + pi01) #> • output is in PAIRS (cases); screening total = pairs/prevalence #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = [Za*sqrt(psi) + Zb*sqrt(psi-delta^2)]^2/delta^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{\psi} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{\psi-\delta^2}\right]^2}{\delta^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Paired binary parameters: p1 = 0.85, p2 = 0.75, discordant pair #> proportion psi = 0.10, difference delta = |p1 - p2| = 0.10. #> • Step 2: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 3: Connor formula: n_pairs = [Z_(alpha/2)*sqrt(psi) + Z_beta*sqrt(psi - #> delta^2)]^2 / delta^2 = 76.09. #> • Step 4: Round up to integer: Pairs needed = 77. #> Reference: #> Primary: Connor, R. J. (1987). Biometrics, 43(1), 207-211. #>  #>  Also: Akoglu, H. (2022). Turkish Journal of Emergency Medicine, 22(4), Table 2 Eq 3b + Tables 6A/6B; Zhou et al. (2011) Section 6.2.2. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 诊断准确度非劣效性检验
previous_headings: 第五章：诊断试验准确性研究全家族
what: 5.7 诊断准确度非劣效性检验
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：新的简便家庭自测盒（敏感度 90%）需证實不劣于实验室金标准（88%），非劣效界值 5%，患病率 30%。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \frac{(Z_{\alpha}+Z_{\beta})^2\left[p_1(1-p_1)+p_2(1-p_2)\right]}{(p_1-p_2+\Delta)^2}\] 出处：Chow et al. (2017)；Zhou et al. (2011) §6.3, pp. 214-218。 输出解读：需 247 例病例，筛查 824 人。
code: res_5_7 <- calculate("diagAccuracyCompare", "noninferiority", "proportion", p1 = 0.90, p2 = 0.88, margin = 0.05, prevalence = 0.30, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_5_7) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Diagnostic non-inferiority (two proportions)" #> • Sample size per group: 247 #> • Total sample size: 494 #> • Cases needed: 247 #> • Total subjects to screen: 823 #> • Total subjects: 823 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • p1/p2 = expected sensitivities (or specificities) of the new/reference test #> • margin = non-inferiority/equivalence margin Delta #> • non-inferiority uses one-sided alpha; equivalence uses Z_{beta/2} #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = (Za+Zb)^2 * (p1q1+p2q2) / (p1-p2+margin)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \frac{(Z_{\alpha}+Z_{\beta})^2\left[p_1(1-p_1)+p_2(1-p_2)\right]}{(p_1-p_2+\Delta)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State non-inferiority hypotheses: H0: p1 - p2 <= -margin vs H1: p1 - #> p2 > -margin (margin Delta = 0.05, one-sided alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Effective difference: delta_E = p1 - p2 + margin = 0.90 - 0.88 + 0.05 #> = 0.07. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: one-sided Z_alpha = 1.6449, Z_beta = #> 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Compute sample size: n = (Z_alpha + Z_beta)^2 * [p1(1-p1) + p2(1-p2)] #> / delta_E^2 = 246.80. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: n = 247 per group, total sample size N = 494. #> Reference: #> Framework: Chow, S. C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). Sample Size Calculations in Clinical Research (3rd ed.). CRC Press (margin designs); Machin et al. (2018) Ch.11. #>  #>  Diagnostic application: Zhou, X.-H., Obuchowski, N. A., & McClish, D. K. (2011). Statistical Methods in Diagnostic Medicine (2nd ed.), Section 6.3 (non-inferiority/equivalency of two tests), pp. 214-218. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

text: 临床场景：两台床旁分析仪敏感度分别为 90% 与 89%，临床可接受等效界值 \(\pm 5\%\)。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \frac{(Z_{\alpha}+Z_{\beta/2})^2\left[p_1(1-p_1)+p_2(1-p_2)\right]}{(\Delta-|p_1-p_2|)^2}\] 出处：Chow et al. (2017)；Zhou et al. (2011) §6.3。 输出解读：需 1006 例病例，筛查 3354 人。

C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). Sample Size Calculations in Clinical Research (3rd ed.). CRC Press (margin designs); Machin et al. (2018) Ch.11. #>  #>  Diagnostic application: Zhou, X.-H., Obuchowski, N. A., & McClish, D. K. (2011). id: roc-曲线下面积auc精度估计双正态模型
previous_headings: 第五章：诊断试验准确性研究全家族
what: 5.9 ROC 曲线下面积（AUC）精度估计（双正态模型）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：预期 \(\text{AUC} = 0.80\)，容许置信区间半宽 \(\pm 0.10\)，病例对照比 1:1。 数学公式与出处：Obuchowski, N. . (1994); Zhou et al. (2011) Eq 6.5. 输出解读：需 46 例病例与 46 例对照（总计 92 人）。
code: res_5_9 <- calculate("diagAUC", "estimate", "auc", auc = 0.80, d = 0.10, ratio = 1, var_method = "binormal", alpha = 0.05) print(res_5_9) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Single-group AUC CI precision" #> • Cases needed: 46 #> • Total subjects to screen: 92 #> • Total subjects: 92 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • auc = anticipated area under the ROC curve #> • precision = desired CI half-width L #> • ratio = case:control ratio R (cases:non-cases; default 1) #> • var_method = binormal variance function #> Formula (plain text): #> `N_cases = (Z_1-a/2 / d)^2 * V(AUC)` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n_{cases} = \left(\frac{Z_{1-\alpha/2}}{d}\right)^2 \cdot V(AUC)$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Anticipated AUC = 0.80, precision d = 0.10, supplied allocation R = #> 1, alpha = 0.05. #> • Step 2: Use the binormal variance model with the supplied allocation: V(AUC) #> = 0.1195. #> • Step 3: Calculate cases: n_cases = (Z_(1-alpha/2)/d)^2 * V(AUC) = #> (1.96/0.10)^2 * 0.1195 = 45.89. #> • Step 4: Convert using the supplied allocation: total = n_cases*(1+R) = #> 45.89*(1+1) = 91.78. #> • Step 5: Round up: Target cases needed = 46, Total subjects to screen = 92. #> Reference: #> Primary: Zhou, X.-H., Obuchowski, N. A., & McClish, D. K. (2011). Statistical Methods in Diagnostic Medicine (2nd ed.). Wiley. Section 6.1.2, pp. 196-199 (Eq 6.4/6.5/6.6; CTC worked example). #>  #>  Original variance: Hanley, J. A., & McNeil, B. J. (1982). Radiology, 143(1), 29-36. #>  Binormal variance: Obuchowski, N. A. (1994). Medical Decision Making, 14(2), 154-162. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

A., & McNeil, B. J. (1982). The meaning and use of the area under a receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve. Radiology, 143(1), 29-36. #>  #> Review: Hajian-Tilaki, K. (2014). what: 5.11 两诊断方法 ROC-AUC 比较
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：两法 \(\text{AUC}_1 = 0.80\) vs \(\text{AUC}_2 = 0.70\)，两法相关系数 \(r = 0.50\)。 数学公式与出处：Hajian-Tilaki (2014) Eq 7.6/7.8. 输出解读：需 223 例病例，筛查 744 人。
code: res_5_11 <- calculate("diagAUCCompare", "test", "auc", auc1 = 0.80, auc2 = 0.70, r = 0.50, prevalence = 0.30, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_5_11) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "AUC comparison (two tests)" #> • Cases needed: 223 #> • Total subjects to screen: 743 #> • Total subjects: 743 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n_cases = 2 * (Z_alpha/2 + Z_beta)^2 * V(AUC) * (1 - r) / (AUC1 - AUC2)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n_{cases} = \frac{2(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta})^2 \cdot V(AUC) \cdot (1-r)}{(AUC_1 - AUC_2)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Specify AUC1 = 0.80, AUC2 = 0.70, correlation r = 0.50, prevalence = #> 0.30 (alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 3: Evaluate pooled Hanley-McNeil variance V(AUC_avg). #> • Step 4: Calculate target cases: n_cases = 2 * (Z_(alpha/2) + Z_beta)^2 * #> V(AUC) * (1 - r) / (AUC1 - AUC2)^2. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: Target cases needed = 223, Total subjects to #> screen = 743. #> Reference: #> Hajian-Tilaki, K. (2014). what: 5.13 两法 ROC-AUC 等效性检验
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：两法 \(\text{AUC}_1 = 0.85\) vs \(\text{AUC}_2 = 0.84\)，等效界值 \(\text{margin} = 0.05\)。 输出解读：需 317 例病例，筛查 634 人。
code: res_5_13 <- calculate("diagAUCCompare", "equivalence", "auc", auc1 = 0.85, auc2 = 0.84, r = 0.50, margin = 0.05, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_5_13) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Diagnostic equivalence (two ROC areas)" #> • Cases needed: 416 #> • Total subjects to screen: 831 #> • Total subjects: 831 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • auc1/auc2 = anticipated ROC areas of the new/reference test #> • r = expected correlation between the two AUC estimates (paired designs) #> • margin = non-inferiority/equivalence margin on the AUC difference #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = 2(Za+Zb/2)^2 * V * (1-r) / (margin-|auc1-auc2|)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \frac{2(Z_{\alpha}+Z_{\beta/2})^2 V(1-r)}{(\Delta-|AUC_1-AUC_2|)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Identify study design: Diagnostic equivalence (two ROC areas). #> • Step 2: Input parameters: auc1 = 0.85, auc2 = 0.84, r = 0.50, margin = 0.05, #> task = equivalence, var_method = exponential, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80. #> • Step 3: Apply design formula: n = 2(Za+Zb/2)^2 * V * (1-r) / #> (margin-|auc1-auc2|)^2. #> • Step 4: Calculated sample size metrics: Cases needed: 416; Total subjects to #> screen: 831. #> Reference: #> Framework: margin designs per Chow et al. (2017); Machin et al. (2018) Ch.11. AUC variance per Zhou et al. (2011) Eq 6.4/6.5/6.6. #>  #>  Diagnostic application: Zhou et al. (2011) Section 6.3, pp. 214-218. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 似然比likelihood-ratio对数置信区间阈值法
previous_headings: 第五章：诊断试验准确性研究全家族
what: 5.14 似然比（Likelihood Ratio）对数置信区间阈值法
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：肺栓塞排除路径要求 D-二聚体的阴性似然比（\(\text{LR}^-\)）95% 置信区间上限不能超过 0.40（\(\text{target\_lr} = 0.40\)），否则排除规则不安全。预期敏感度 90%，特异度 50%。 数学公式与出处： \[\log(LR) \pm Z_{1-\alpha/2}\sqrt{\frac{1-Se}{n \cdot Se} + \frac{1-Sp}{n \cdot Sp}}\] 出处：Hajian-Tilaki (2014) Eq 6.14; Simel et al. (1991). 输出解读：病例与对照各需 9 例，总计 18 人。
code: res_5_14 <- calculate("diagLR", "estimate", "lr", sens = 0.90, spec = 0.50, target_lr = 0.40, lr_type = "negative", alpha = 0.05) print(res_5_14) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Likelihood ratio (negative, log-CI method)" #> • Cases needed: 9 #> • Controls needed: 9 #> • Total subjects: 18 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • sens/spec = expected sensitivity/specificity (determine the observed LR) #> • target_lr = LR boundary the CI must not cross (precision target) #> • n is computed per group (equal cases and controls) #> ! Calculates sample size ensuring the log-scale CI does not cross target_lr (threshold precision), #> ! distinct from fixed-width CI approaches (e.g. prec_lr in presize). #>  #> Formula (plain text): #> `log(LR) +- Z * sqrt((1-Se)/(n*Se) + (1-Sp)/(n*Sp))` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$\log(LR) \pm Z_{1-\alpha/2}\sqrt{\frac{1-Se}{n \cdot Se} + \frac{1-Sp}{n \cdot Sp}}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Identify study design: Likelihood ratio (negative, log-CI method). #> • Step 2: Input parameters: sensitivity = 0.90, specificity = 0.50, lr_type = #> negative, lr_observed = 0.20, target_lr = 0.40, prevalence = 1, alpha = 0.05. #> • Step 3: Apply design formula: log(LR) +- Z * sqrt((1-Se)/(n*Se) + #> (1-Sp)/(n*Sp)). #> • Step 4: Calculated sample size metrics: Total sample size: 18; Cases needed: #> 9; Controls needed: 9; Total subjects: 18. #> Reference: #> Primary: Hajian-Tilaki, K. (2014). Sample size estimation in diagnostic test studies of biomedical informatics. Journal of Biomedical Informatics, 48, 193-204 (Section 6.4, Eqs 6.13/6.14; worked example n=80 per group). #>  #>  CI method: Simel, D. L., Samsa, G. P., & Matchar, D. B. (1991). Likelihood ratios with confidence: sample size estimation for accuracy of a diagnostic test. Journal of Clinical Epidemiology, 44(11), 1123-1130. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 临床真实筛查总人数的二项安全保障screen_required
previous_headings: 第五章：诊断试验准确性研究全家族
what: 5.15 临床真实筛查总人数的“二项安全保障”（screen_required）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：理论平均筛查 980 人才能抓够 196 例确诊病例，但这只有 50% 的把握。筛查名单应扩大到多少人，才能以 90% 概率保障抓满 196 例？ 数学公式与出处： \[P(\text{Binomial}(N, \text{prev}) \ge n) \ge 1 - \beta\] 出处：Zhou et al. (2011) Eq 6.3。 输出解读：实际筛查名单需扩大至 1058 人（多储备 78 人备荒）。
code: safe_n <- screen_required(n = 196, prevalence = 0.20, beta = 0.10) cat("理论平均筛查数：980 人；90% 概率安全保障筛查数：", safe_n, "人\n") #> 理论平均筛查数：980 人；90% 概率安全保障筛查数： 1061 人

id: 多阅片者多病例mrmc研究效能分析
previous_headings: 第五章：诊断试验准确性研究全家族
what: 5.16 多阅片者多病例（MRMC）研究效能分析
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：乳腺钼靶 AI 辅助诊断研究：8 名放射科医生独立阅读 50 例病例，比较常规钼靶与断层合成两种技术的 AUC 差异（\(\Delta = 0.10\)）。 数学公式与出处：Obuchowski-Rockette 混合效应模型非中心 \(F\) 检验，Zhou et al. (2011) Eq 6.32, p.225. 输出解读：在 50 例病例、8 名阅片者下，该试验达到 88.8% 的统计学效能（与教材报道的 89% 一致）。
code: res_5_16 <- mrmc_power(n = 50, J = 8, delta = 0.10, sigma_b2 = 0.00123, sigma_w2 = 0.00087, sigma_c2 = 0.05, rho1 = 0.25, rho2 = 0.20, rho3 = 0.10) print(res_5_16) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "MRMC (paired-patient, paired-reader, Obuchowski-Rockette)" #> Parameter roles #>  #> • n = cases per test (paired-patient: total cases) #> • J = readers per test #> • delta = accuracy difference to detect #> • sigma_b2/sigma_w2/sigma_c2 = reader/occasion/case variance components #> • rho1/rho2/rho3 = correlations (same-reader-diff-test / diff-reader-same-test #> / diff-reader-diff-test) #> ! MRMC power depends on 6 variance/correlation components estimated from #> ! pilot data or literature (Zhou Table 6.3); treat results as approximate. #> ! For reader variability planning: sigma_b2 = (accuracy range / 4)^2 is a #> ! common heuristic (Zhou p. 223, Beam 1996 mammography example). #>  #> Formula (plain text): #> `lambda = J*delta^2/(2*[sb2(1-r1) + sw2/Q + sc2(1-r1)/n + #> r2*sb2*((1-r1)+(J-1)(r2-r3))]); power = P(F_{1,J-1}(lambda) > F_{1-alpha})` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$\lambda = \frac{J \cdot \delta^2}{2\left[\sigma_b^2(1-r_1) + \frac{\sigma_w^2}{Q} + \frac{\sigma_c^2(1-r_1)}{n} + r_2 \sigma_b^2((1-r_1)+(J-1)(r_2-r_3))\right]}, \quad \text{Power} = P(F_{1,J-1}(\lambda) > F_{1-\alpha})$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Identify study design: MRMC (paired-patient, paired-reader, #> Obuchowski-Rockette). #> • Step 2: Input parameters: n = 50, J = 8, delta = 0.10, sigma_b2 = 0.0012, #> sigma_w2 = 0.0009, sigma_c2 = 0.05, rho1 = 0.25, rho2 = 0.20, rho3 = 0.10, #> alpha = 0.05, n_repeats = 1, noncentrality_lambda = 13.7969. #> • Step 3: Apply design formula: lambda = J*delta^2/(2*[sb2(1-r1) + sw2/Q + #> sc2(1-r1)/n + r2*sb2*((1-r1)+(J-1)(r2-r3))]); power = P(F_{1,J-1}(lambda) > #> F_{1-alpha}). #> Reference: #> Primary: Zhou, X.-H., Obuchowski, N. A., & McClish, D. K. (2011). Statistical Methods in Diagnostic Medicine (2nd ed.). Wiley. Section 6.5, Eq 6.32, Tables 6.3-6.5, pp. 220-226 (mammography worked example). #>  #>  Model: Obuchowski, N. A., & Rockette, H. E. (1995). Hypothesis testing of diagnostic accuracy for multiple readers, multiple tests. Communications in Statistics - Simulation and Computation, 24, 285-308. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 群随机试验cluster-rct连续型结局
previous_headings: 第六章：复杂与现代前沿临床研究设计
what: 6.1 群随机试验（Cluster RCT：连续型结局）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：以 ICU 病区（而非患者）为随机单位评价新导管护理包：并发症均分由 10 降至 12，\(\text{SD} = 3\)，每病区平均 20 张床位，组内相关系数 \(\text{ICC} = 0.05\)。 数学公式与出处： \[DE = 1 + (m - 1) \times ICC = 1.95, \quad n_{clusters} = \left\lceil \frac{n_{individual} \times DE}{m} \right\rceil\] 出处：Donner & Klar (2000)；Machin et al. (2018) Ch.12。 输出解读：每个干预臂需 4 个病区（80 人），两臂共计 8 个病区（160 人）。
code: res_6_1 <- calculate("clusterRCT", "test", "mean", mean1 = 10, mean2 = 12, sd = 3, icc = 0.05, cluster_size = 20, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_6_1) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Cluster RCT: Two independent samples, mean comparison" #> • Sample size per group: 80 #> • Total sample size: 160 #> • Clusters per arm: 4 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • icc = 0.05, cluster_size = 20 -> DE = 1.95; n_clusters per arm = 4 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = 2 * ((Z_alpha/2 + Z_beta) * sd / (mean1 - mean2))^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = 2\left(\frac{Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta}}{\delta}\right)^2 = 2\left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta}) \cdot \sigma}{\mu_1 - \mu_2}\right)^2$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Compute individual-level sample size without clustering from standard #> two-group formulas. #> • Step 2: Calculate design effect (inflation factor): DE = 1 + (cluster_size - #> 1) * ICC = 1 + (20 - 1) * 0.05 = 1.95. #> • Step 3: Inflate sample size for clustering: n_clustered = n_individual * DE. #> • Step 4: Determine clusters required per arm: n_clusters = ceiling(n_clustered #> / cluster_size) = 4. #> • Step 5: Total individuals per arm = 4 * 20 = 80; Total sample size N = 160. #> Reference: #> Primary: Machin, D., Campbell, M. J., Tan, S. B., & Tan, S. H. (2018). Sample Sizes for Clinical, Laboratory and Epidemiology Studies (4th ed.). Wiley. Chapter 12 (Cluster Designs); Donner, A., & Klar, N. (2000). Design and Analysis of Cluster Randomisation Trials in Health Research. Arnold. #>  #>  Chow, S. C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). *Sample size calculations in clinical research* (3rd ed.). CRC Press. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 群随机试验cluster-rct二分类结局
previous_headings: 第六章：复杂与现代前沿临床研究设计
what: 6.2 群随机试验（Cluster RCT：二分类结局）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：以行政村为单位随机化一项筛查依从性干预：筛查率由 20% 提高至 30%，每村平均 20 名居民，\(\text{ICC} = 0.05\)。 数学公式与出处：设计效应同 6.1（\(DE = 1 + (m-1)ICC\)），基础样本量用两比例核（Fleiss 1980）。 输出解读：每臂需 29 个社区（580 人），共计 58 个社区（1160 人）。
code: res_6_2 <- calculate("clusterRCT", "test", "proportion", p1 = 0.30, p2 = 0.20, icc = 0.05, cluster_size = 20, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_6_2) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Cluster RCT: Two independent proportions" #> • Sample size per group: 580 #> • Total sample size: 1160 #> • Clusters per arm: 29 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • icc = 0.05, cluster_size = 20 -> DE = 1.95; n_clusters per arm = 29 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = (Z_a/2 * sqrt(2*p_bar*(1-p_bar)) + Z_b * sqrt(p1*(1-p1)+p2*(1-p2)))^2 / #> (p1-p2)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{2\bar{p}(1-\bar{p})} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p_1(1-p_1) + p_2(1-p_2)}\right]^2}{(p_1 - p_2)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Compute individual-level sample size without clustering from standard #> two-group formulas. #> • Step 2: Calculate design effect (inflation factor): DE = 1 + (cluster_size - #> 1) * ICC = 1 + (20 - 1) * 0.05 = 1.95. #> • Step 3: Inflate sample size for clustering: n_clustered = n_individual * DE. #> • Step 4: Determine clusters required per arm: n_clusters = ceiling(n_clustered #> / cluster_size) = 29. #> • Step 5: Total individuals per arm = 29 * 20 = 580; Total sample size N = #> 1160. #> Reference: #> Primary: Machin, D., Campbell, M. J., Tan, S. B., & Tan, S. H. (2018). Sample Sizes for Clinical, Laboratory and Epidemiology Studies (4th ed.). Wiley. Chapter 12 (Cluster Designs); Donner, A., & Klar, N. (2000). Design and Analysis of Cluster Randomisation Trials in Health Research. Arnold. #>  #>  Primary (formula as implemented, without continuity correction): Fleiss, J. L., Tytun, A., & Ury, H. K. (1980). A simple approximation for calculating sample sizes for comparing independent proportions. Biometrics, 36(2), 343-346. #>  #> With continuity correction: Casagrande, J. T., Pike, M. C., & Smith, P. G. (1978). An improved approximate formula for calculating sample sizes for comparing two binomial distributions. Biometrics, 34(3), 483-494. #>  #> Book: Fleiss, J. L., Levin, B., & Paik, M. C. (2003). Statistical methods for rates and proportions (3rd ed.). Wiley. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

previous_headings: 第六章：复杂与现代前沿临床研究设计
what: 6.3 阶梯楔形整群试验（Stepped-Wedge CRT）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：24 个县分 4 批阶梯交叉推行手卫生干预（基线 + 4 个阶梯，每步 6 县，每县每期 100 名新生儿）。感染风险的治疗效应 \(\theta = -0.016\)。 数学公式与出处： \[Var(\hat{\theta}) = \frac{\tau^2 (\tau^2 + T\sigma^2)}{(IU - W)\tau^2 + (U^2 + ITU - TW - IV)\sigma^2}, \quad \text{power} = \Phi\left(|\theta|/SE - z_{1-\alpha/2}\right)\] 出处：Hussey, M. ., & Hughes, J. P. (2007). Contemp Clin Trials, 28(2), 182-191 (Eq 8). 输出解读：该阶梯楔形方案实现 90.8% 的检验效能。
code: res_6_3 <- calculate("steppedWedge", "test", "mean", theta = -0.016, tau2 = 2.25e-4, sigma2_ind = 0.0475, m = 100, n_clusters = 24, clusters_per_step = 6, alpha = 0.05) print(res_6_3) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Stepped wedge cluster trial (Hussey-Hughes, mean outcome)" #> • Clusters per arm: 24 #> • Power achieved: 0.908 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • theta = treatment effect (additive scale; e.g. risk difference) #> • tau2 = between-cluster variance (e.g. (CV*mean)^2) #> • sigma2_ind = individual-level variance (binary: p(1-p)) #> • m = individuals sampled per cluster per time point #> • clusters_per_step = clusters randomized at each step (full design) #> ! Hussey & Hughes (2007) Eq 8 assumes no underlying calendar time trends. #> ! If secular time trends are present, statistical power may be lower; #> ! consider incorporating time fixed effects via simulation or swCRTdesign. #>  #> Formula (plain text): #> `Var = I*t2*(t2+T*s2)/((I*U-W)*t2 + (U^2+I*T*U-T*W-I*V)*s2); power = #> Phi(|theta|/se - z)` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$\text{Var}(\hat{\theta}) = \frac{I \tau^2(\tau^2+T\sigma^2)}{(IU-W)\tau^2 + (U^2+ITU-TW-IV)\sigma^2}, \quad \sigma^2 = \sigma_{ind}^2/m, \quad \text{Power} = \Phi\left(\frac{|\theta|}{\text{SE}} - z_{1-\alpha/2}\right)$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Identify study design: Stepped wedge cluster trial (Hussey-Hughes, #> mean outcome). #> • Step 2: Input parameters: theta = -0.016, tau2 = 0.0002, sigma2_ind = 0.0475, #> m = 100, n_clusters = 24, clusters_per_step = 6, alpha = 0.05. #> • Step 3: Apply design formula: Var = I*t2*(t2+T*s2)/((I*U-W)*t2 + #> (U^2+I*T*U-T*W-I*V)*s2); power = Phi(|theta|/se - z). #> • Step 4: Calculated sample size metrics: Clusters per arm: 24; Power achieved: #> 0.908. #> Reference: #> Primary: Hussey, M. A., & Hughes, J. P. (2007). Design and analysis of stepped wedge cluster randomized trials. Contemporary Clinical Trials, 28(2), 182-191 (Eq 8; EPT worked example I=24, T=5). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 有序多分类结局whitehead-比例优势比模型
previous_headings: 第六章：复杂与现代前沿临床研究设计
what: 6.4 有序多分类结局（Whitehead 比例优势比模型）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：膝骨关节炎疼痛缓解程度分轻度/中度/重度三级（预期分布 20%/50%/30%），新的关节腔注射疗法预期使更高级别缓解的比值比 \(\text{} = 1.5\)。 数学公式与出处： \[N = \frac{3\,(Z_{\alpha/2}+Z_{\beta})^2}{(\log )^2\,(1-\sum \bar{p}_j^3)}\] 出处：Whitehead, J. (1993). Stat Med, 12(24), 2257-2271. 输出解读：每组需 86 人，总计 171 人。
code: res_6_4 <- calculate("twoOrdinal", "test", "ordinal", or = 1.5, prop_bar = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.3), alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_6_4) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Two-group ordered categorical outcome (Mann-Whitney / #> proportional odds)" #> • Sample size per group: 86 #> • Total sample size: 171 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • or = anticipated odds ratio (proportional odds) #> • prop_bar = anticipated average category proportions (sums to 1) #> • output: total N and per-group n (equal allocation) #> Formula (plain text): #> `N = 3(Za/2+Zb)^2 / ((log OR)^2 * (1 - sum(p_bar^3)))` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$N = \frac{3\,(Z_{\alpha/2}+Z_{\beta})^2}{(\log OR)^2\,(1-\sum \bar{p}_j^3)}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Specify odds ratio OR = 1.50, pooled proportion categories = [0.20, #> 0.50, 0.30]. #> • Step 2: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 3: Compute Whitehead variance factor: 1 - sum(p_bar_j^3). #> • Step 4: Whitehead formula: N = 3 * (Z_(alpha/2) + Z_beta)^2 / [(ln OR)^2 * (1 #> - sum(p_bar^3))]. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: Total sample size N = 171, per group n = 86. #> Reference: #> Primary: Whitehead, J. (1993). Sample size calculations for ordered categorical data. Statistics in Medicine, 12(24), 2257-2271. #>  #>  Also: Machin et al. (2018) Chapter 4 (Ordered Categorical Outcomes). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 临床预测模型开发riley-2020-bmj-准则二分类结局
previous_headings: 第六章：复杂与现代前沿临床研究设计
what: 6.5 临床预测模型开发：Riley 2020 BMJ 准则（二分类结局）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：开发 ICU 住院死亡预测模型：10 个候选预测变量，结局发生率 30%，预期 Cox-Snell \(R^2_{CS} = 0.10\)，目标收缩因子 \(S = 0.90\)，新增参数需多少患者与事件数？ 数学公式与出处： \[n_{B1} = \left(\frac{z}{\delta}\right)^2 \phi(1-\phi), \quad n_{B3} = \frac{P}{(S-1)\ln(1-R^2_{CS}/S)}, \quad n = \max(n_{B1}, n_{B3})\] 出处：Riley et al. (2020). BMJ, 368, m441 (Box 1 准则 B1 与 B3; 与 pmsampsize 一致)。 输出解读：需纳入 850 名患者，其中包含 255 例事件（有效事件参数比 EPP=25.5，与 pmsampsize 结果完全一致）。

B1 (proportion precision, delta=0.050): n = 323 #> ! B3 (shrinkage S=0.90, R2cs=0.1000): n = 850 #> ! B2 (MAPE=0.050, P=10 <= 30): n = 461 (informational) #> ! B4 (optimism in Nagelkerke R2 <= 0.05) is handled inside B3 via the #> ! shrinkage target in the pmsampsize implementation; see Riley 2020 Box 1. #>  #> Formula (plain text): #> `B1: n=(z/d)^2*p(1-p); B3: n=P/((S-1)*ln(1-R2cs/S)); n = max(B1, B3)` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n_{B1} = \left(\frac{z_{1-\alpha/2}}{\delta}\right)^2 \phi(1-\phi), \quad n_{B3} = \frac{p}{(S-1)\ln(1 - R_{CS}^2/S)}, \quad n = \max(n_{B1}, n_{B3})$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Identify study design: Prediction model development (Riley 2020, #> binary). #> • Step 2: Input parameters: prev = 0.30, n_parameters = 10, r2_cs = 0.10, #> max_r2cs = 0.7053, shrinkage = 0.90, mape = 0.05, precision_delta = 0.05, alpha #> = 0.05. #> • Step 3: Apply design formula: B1: n=(z/d)^2*p(1-p); B3: #> n=P/((S-1)*ln(1-R2cs/S)); n = max(B1, B3). #> • Step 4: Calculated sample size metrics: Required sample size: 850; Total #> sample size: 850; Events required: 255. #> Reference: #> Primary: Riley, R. D., Ensor, J., Snell, K. I. E., et al. (2020). Calculating the sample size required for developing a clinical prediction model. BMJ, 368, m441 (Box 1, Figures 1-5). #>  #>  B2 formula: van Smeden, M., et al. (2019). Stat Methods Med Res, 28, 2455-74. B3 derivation: Riley et al. (2019). Stat Med, 38, 1276-96 (PART II). title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：开发 10 年心血管死亡预测模型：队列年发病率 0.10/年，要求 10 年累计发病率 \(F(10)\) 的估计误差不超过 \(\pm 5\%\)，需要多少随访人年？ 数学公式与出处：\(F(t) = 1 - e^{-\lambda t}\)；求解使人年数 \(T\) 满足 \(F(t)\) 双侧置信限误差均 \(\le \delta\)（准则 T1）。Riley et al. (2020). BMJ, 368, m441 (Figure 1)。 输出解读：需随访累计 2366 人年。
code: res_6_6 <- calculate("predictiveModel", "plan", "rate", rate = 0.10, timepoint = 10, precision_delta = 0.05, alpha = 0.05) print(res_6_6) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Prediction model development (Riley 2020, time-to-event)" #> • Required person-time: 2366 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • rate = anticipated event rate per person-year #> • timepoint = key prediction time point t (years) #> • precision_delta = maximum margin of error for F(t) #> • n_parameters/epv = optional EPP cross-check (classic 10 EPV) #> Formula (plain text): #> `F(t) = 1-exp(-rate*t); CI: 1-exp(-(rate +- z*sqrt(rate/T))*t); find T with #> margins <= delta` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$F(t) = 1 - e^{-\lambda t}, \quad \text{CI: } 1 - \exp\left(-\left(\lambda \pm z_{1-\alpha/2}\sqrt{\frac{\lambda}{T}}\right)t\right)$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Identify study design: Prediction model development (Riley 2020, #> time-to-event). #> • Step 2: Input parameters: rate = 0.10, timepoint = 10, precision_delta = #> 0.05, alpha = 0.05, n_parameters = , epv = . #> • Step 3: Apply design formula: F(t) = 1-exp(-rate*t); CI: 1-exp(-(rate +- #> z*sqrt(rate/T))*t); find T with margins <= delta. #> • Step 4: Calculated sample size metrics: Required person-time: 2366. #> Reference: #> Primary: Riley, R. D., Ensor, J., Snell, K. I. E., et al. (2020). Calculating the sample size required for developing a clinical prediction model. BMJ, 368, m441 (Figure 1, time-to-event panel; criterion T1; worked example: rate=0.10/year, t=10y, delta=0.05 -> 2366 person-years). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：标书快速粗算：10 个候选预测变量的 logistic 回归模型，结局事件发生率 30%，按经典每变量 10 事件规则需要多少样本？ 数学公式与出处： \[n_{events} = EPV \times k, \quad n_{subjects} = n_{events} / \pi\] 出处：Peduzzi et al. (1996). J Clin Epidemiol, 49(12), 1373-1379. 输出解读：需 100 例事件，总共需调查 334 人。

EPV >= 10 is a minimum heuristic; Riley et al. (2019, BMJ 364:l951) #> ! provide a modern precision-based alternative (planned for a later release). #>  #> Formula (plain text): #> `n_events = EPV * k ; n_subjects = n_events / prevalence` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n_{events} = EPV \times k, \quad n_{subjects} = n_{events} / \pi$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Specify candidate predictor parameters k = 10, Events Per Variable #> target EPV = 10. #> • Step 2: Calculate required events: n_events = EPV * k = 10 * 10 = 100. #> • Step 3: Convert to subjects using event prevalence pi = 0.30: n_subjects = #> n_events / prevalence = 334. #> • Step 4: Required events = 100, Total subjects = 334. #> Reference: #> Primary: Peduzzi, P., Concato, J., Kemper, E., Holford, T. R., & Feinstein, A. R. (1996). A simulation study of the number of events per variable in logistic regression analysis. what: 6.8 评分者一致性：Cohen’s Kappa 置信区间精度估计
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：两位放射科医生独立判读同一批乳腺钼靶片：预期一致性 \(\kappa = 0.70\)，要求 95% 置信区间半宽不超过 \(\pm 0.10\)，需多少受试者/标本？ 数学公式与出处： \[n = Q\left(\frac{z_{1-\alpha/2}}{d}\right)^2, \quad Q = \frac{p_o(1-p_o)}{(1-p_e)^2}\] 出处：Cantor, . B. (1996). Psychol Methods, 1(2), 150-153. 输出解读：需调查 165 名受试者。
code: res_6_8 <- calculate("kappa", "estimate", "proportion", pi1 = 0.30, pi2 = 0.30, kappa = 0.70, d = 0.10, alpha = 0.05) print(res_6_8) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Cohen's kappa estimation (CI precision)" #> • Required sample size: 165 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • pi1/pi2 = expected Rating-1 proportions for rater 1 / rater 2 #> • kappa1 = planning value of kappa #> • d = desired CI half-width #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = Q * (z/d)^2 ; Q = p_o(1-p_o)/(1-p_e)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = Q\left(\frac{z_{1-\alpha/2}}{d}\right)^2, \quad Q = \frac{p_o(1-p_o)}{(1-p_e)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Identify study design: Cohen's kappa estimation (CI precision). #> • Step 2: Input parameters: pi1 = 0.30, pi2 = 0.30, kappa = 0.70, d = 0.10, #> alpha = 0.05, Q = 0.4272. #> • Step 3: Apply design formula: n = Q * (z/d)^2 ; Q = p_o(1-p_o)/(1-p_e)^2. #> • Step 4: Calculated sample size metrics: Required sample size: 165; Total #> sample size: 165. #> Reference: #> Primary: Cantor, A. B. (1996). Sample-size calculations for Cohen's kappa. Psychological Methods, 1(2), 150-153 (Fleiss-Cohen-Everitt 1969 asymptotic variance; worked examples N=165 and N=214). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 评分者一致性两独立-kappa-系数差异检验
previous_headings: 第六章：复杂与现代前沿临床研究设计
what: 6.9 评分者一致性：两独立 Kappa 系数差异检验
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：比较新结构化报告清单（预期 \(\kappa_1 = 0.70\)）与传统阅片（预期 \(\kappa_2 = 0.50\)）在两组独立阅片者中的一致性是否显著提升，每组各需多少阅片者/标本？ 数学公式与出处： \[n = \frac{\left[z_{\alpha}\sqrt{2Q_1} + z_{\beta}\sqrt{Q_1+Q_2}\right]^2}{(K_1-K_2)^2}\] 出处：Cantor, . B. (1996). Psychol Methods, 1(2), 150-153. 输出解读：两组各需评估 214 例标本。
code: res_6_9 <- calculate("kappa", "test", "proportion", pi1 = 0.50, pi2 = 0.50, kappa1 = 0.70, kappa2 = 0.50, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_6_9) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Cohen's kappa test (two independent kappas)" #> • Required sample size: 214 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • pi1/pi2 = expected Rating-1 proportions (both raters/groups) #> • kappa1 = kappa under the null (e.g. questionnaire 1) #> • kappa2 = kappa under the alternative (e.g. questionnaire 2) #> • n is per group (two independent kappa estimates) #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = (z_a*sqrt(2*Q1) + z_b*sqrt(Q1+Q2))^2/(K1-K2)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \frac{\left[z_{\alpha}\sqrt{2Q_1} + z_{\beta}\sqrt{Q_1+Q_2}\right]^2}{(K_1-K_2)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Identify study design: Cohen's kappa test (two independent kappas). #> • Step 2: Input parameters: pi1 = 0.50, pi2 = 0.50, kappa1 = 0.70, kappa2 = #> 0.50, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80, Q_null = 0.51, Q_alt = 0.75. #> • Step 3: Apply design formula: n = (z_a*sqrt(2*Q1) + #> z_b*sqrt(Q1+Q2))^2/(K1-K2)^2. #> • Step 4: Calculated sample size metrics: Required sample size: 214; Total #> sample size: 214. #> Reference: #> Primary: Cantor, A. B. (1996). Sample-size calculations for Cohen's kappa. Psychological Methods, 1(2), 150-153 (worked example: K1=0.7, K2=0.5, pi=0.5 -> N=214). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

what: 6.10 中断时间序列研究（Interrupted Time Series, ITS）
title: sampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 临床场景：某市对含糖饮料征收“糖税”的政策评估：干预前后各监测 12 个月度消费量时点，预期政策产生 2 个结局标准差的水平跃升（\(\delta = 2\)），月度数据自相关系数 \(\rho = 0.30\)。 数学公式与出处： \[\text{power} = \Phi\left(\frac{\delta}{SE} - z_{\alpha/2}\right), \quad SE = \sqrt{\tfrac{1}{n_{eff}^{pre}} + \tfrac{1}{n_{eff}^{post}}}, \quad n_{eff} = \frac{n(1-\rho)}{1+\rho}\] 出处：Bernal et al. (2017). Int J Epidemiol, 46(1), 348-355（AR(1) 校正近似，试验性方法）。 输出解读：在该序列配置下，可实现 94.9% 的检验效能。
code: res_6_10 <- calculate("its", "test", "rate", effect_sd = 2, n_pre = 12, n_post = 12, rho = 0.3, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_6_10) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Interrupted time series (level change, AR(1)-adjusted)" #> • Power achieved: 0.949 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • effect_sd = anticipated level change in outcome SD units #> • n_pre/n_post = number of time points before/after the interruption #> • rho = AR(1) autocorrelation of the series #> ! EXPERIMENTAL method: transparent AR(1)-adjusted normal approximation. #> ! Bernal et al. (2017, Int J Epidemiol) recommend >= 8 time points per segment; #> ! rigorous ITS power calculations require simulation. #>  #> Formula (plain text): #> `power = Phi(effect/SE - z); SE = sqrt(1/n_eff_pre + 1/n_eff_post); n_eff = #> n(1-rho)/(1+rho)` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$\text{power} = \Phi\left(\frac{\delta}{SE} - z_{\alpha/2}\right), \quad SE = \sqrt{\tfrac{1}{n_{eff}^{pre}} + \tfrac{1}{n_{eff}^{post}}}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Identify study design: Interrupted time series (level change, #> AR(1)-adjusted). #> • Step 2: Input parameters: effect_sd = 2, n_pre = 12, n_post = 12, rho = 0.30, #> alpha = 0.05. #> • Step 3: Apply design formula: power = Phi(effect/SE - z); SE = #> sqrt(1/n_eff_pre + 1/n_eff_post); n_eff = n(1-rho)/(1+rho). #> • Step 4: Calculated sample size metrics: Power achieved: 0.949. #> Reference: #> Framework: Bernal, J. L., Cummins, S., & Gasparrini, A. (2017). Interrupted time series regression for the evaluation of public health interventions: a tutorial. International Journal of Epidemiology, 46(1), 348-355. Sample-size content is a transparent approximation, not from a validated source. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). *Sample size calculations in clinical research* (3rd ed.). C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). *Sample size calculations in clinical research* (3rd ed.). CRC Press. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> calculate("cohort", "test", "proportion", p0 = 0.20, p1 = 0.30, dropout = 0.10) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Cohort study (cumulative incidence, RR)" #> • Sample size per group: 327 #> • Exposed group: 327 #> • Unexposed group: 327 #> • Total sample size: 654 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • p0 = unexposed-group cumulative incidence #> • p1 = exposed-group cumulative incidence #> • ratio = unexposed:exposed allocation (m) #> • effect measure: risk ratio RR (estimable in cohort designs) #> Formula (plain text): #> `n1 = [Za*sqrt((1+1/m)*pbar*(1-pbar)) + Zb*sqrt(p1q1+p0q0/m)]^2/(p1-p0)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n_{1} = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{(1+\frac{1}{m})\bar{p}(1-\bar{p})} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p_1(1-p_1)+\frac{p_0(1-p_0)}{m}}\right]^2}{(p_1-p_0)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Specify proportions: unexposed p0 = 0.20, exposed p1 = 0.30, #> allocation ratio m = 1 (alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Weighted average proportion: p_bar = (p1 + m*p0) / (1 + m) = 0.25. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Calculate exposed sample size: n_exposed = #> [Z_(alpha/2)*sqrt((1+1/m)*p_bar*(1-p_bar)) + Z_beta*sqrt(p1*q1 + p0*q0/m)]^2 / #> (p1 - p0)^2 = 293.15. #> • Step 5: Calculate unexposed sample size: n_unexposed = m * n_exposed = 1 * #> 293.15 = 293.15. #> • Step 6: Round up before dropout inflation: ceiling(n_exposed) = 294, #> ceiling(m*n_exposed) = 294; apply dropout d = 0.10 using ceiling(n/(1-d)). #> Exposed = 327, Unexposed = 327, Total sample size N = 654. #> Reference: #> Primary: Bhardwaj et al. (2024). Journal of Family Medicine and Primary Care, 13(7), 2559 (worked example: p0=0.20, p1=0.30, m=1 -> 293/group). #>  #>  Also: Schlesselman, J. J. (1982). Case-Control Studies. Oxford University Press (cohort/case-control shared formula, roles swapped); Machin et al. (2018) Ch.3. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> calculate("diagAUC", "estimate", "auc",   auc = 0.80, d = 0.10,   ratio = 1, var_method = "binormal" ) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Single-group AUC CI precision" #> • Cases needed: 46 #> • Total subjects to screen: 92 #> • Total subjects: 92 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • auc = anticipated area under the ROC curve #> • precision = desired CI half-width L #> • ratio = case:control ratio R (cases:non-cases; default 1) #> • var_method = binormal variance function #> Formula (plain text): #> `N_cases = (Z_1-a/2 / d)^2 * V(AUC)` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n_{cases} = \left(\frac{Z_{1-\alpha/2}}{d}\right)^2 \cdot V(AUC)$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Anticipated AUC = 0.80, precision d = 0.10, supplied allocation R = #> 1, alpha = 0.05. #> • Step 2: Use the binormal variance model with the supplied allocation: V(AUC) #> = 0.1195. #> • Step 3: Calculate cases: n_cases = (Z_(1-alpha/2)/d)^2 * V(AUC) = #> (1.96/0.10)^2 * 0.1195 = 45.89. #> • Step 4: Convert using the supplied allocation: total = n_cases*(1+R) = #> 45.89*(1+1) = 91.78. #> • Step 5: Round up: Target cases needed = 46, Total subjects to screen = 92. #> Reference: #> Primary: Zhou, X.-H., Obuchowski, N. A., & McClish, D. K. (2011). Statistical Methods in Diagnostic Medicine (2nd ed.). Wiley. Section 6.1.2, pp. 196-199 (Eq 6.4/6.5/6.6; CTC worked example). #>  #>  Original variance: Hanley, J. A., & McNeil, B. J. (1982). Radiology, 143(1), 29-36. #>  Binormal variance: Obuchowski, N. A. (1994). Medical Decision Making, 14(2), 154-162. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>
